name: Introw PRM
description:
Introw is the AI-native, CRM-native partner relationship management platform for B2B teams running referral, co-sell, reseller, distributor, implementation, and affiliate programs. It lives on top of HubSpot or Salesforce with two-way sync, so your CRM stays the single source of truth.

Connect Introw to query and act on your partner program in plain language: check pipeline and partner-sourced revenue, prep a QBR, look up commissions, tiers, goals, and MDF budgets, approve or decline a deal registration, create tasks, post partner-facing comments, and update partner or CRM fields — with every write flowing back to your CRM.

The connector authenticates as you over a one-time OAuth sign-in, acts only within your own Introw permissions, and can be disconnected at any time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Introw PRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Introw PRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.introw.io/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Introw PRM MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Introw PRM lists 22 MCP tools, including add_partner_comment, create_partner_task, create_scorm_upload, find_relevant_content, get_commission_information, get_marketing_funds_information, get_partner_goals, get_partner_tier_information, list_certificates, list_courses, prepare_partner_business_review, and process_form_submission.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Introw PRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Introw PRM in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Introw PRM MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Introw PRM requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Introw PRM is developed by Introw PRM. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
